mapper.select: SELECT * FROM file_assets WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE file_assets SET object_key = #{objectKey}, etag = #{etag}, metadata = #{metadata,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.nep.tsuki.infra.persistence.mybatis.PostgresJsonbTypeHandler}, status = #{targetStatus}, unbound_expires_at = #{unboundExpiresAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{assetId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM file_assets WHERE status = 'READY' AND owner_type IS NULL AND unbound_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND unbound_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY unbound_expires_at, id LIMIT #{batchSize}
